notes: Product pages were found in https://www.questhealth.com/sitemap_0.xml. Prices are in each page's server-rendered HTML (price-formatted and pwn-fee-price), so no price JSON was needed. robots.txt disallows /on/demandware.store paths; none were fetched.

Each page shows the test price plus a $6.00 Physician Service Fee. cashCents adds the two for one test in one order. The pages do not say whether the fee is charged once per order or once per test, so ordering both tests together may cost less than the two cashCents added together (not checked; no cart or checkout calls were made). Tax was not checked.

CPT codes are not printed on questhealth.com. Quest's test directory (testdirectory.questdiagnostics.com) loads test details from an API that needs app credentials, so it was not used. The codes here are matched from each page's own description and are marked codeEvidence.verified = false.
The pages do not list a separate fee for the draw at a Quest location. In-home collection costs extra where it is offered (see otherQuotes).
The committed evidence copies of the product pages redact Quest's Stripe publishable key, a public checkout key embedded in every page.
These are national online prices for ordering the test directly, with the draw at a Quest location. They are not tied to one location and are not hospital prices.
